diagnosis.headline: Your wallet is not approved to move that much USDC: it is allowed 0 USDC and the transaction needed 0.000001 USDC.
diagnosis.why: Moving tokens on someone else's behalf needs their permission first (an "approval" that sets how much the spender may take). Your wallet was allowed 0 USDC but tried to take 0.000001 USDC, so the token contract stopped it.
fix: The token's owner must approve first: from the owner's wallet call approve(0x317bca01Bb101C0F1E86C21576a4e14D92B02975, 0.000001 USDC or more) on the token 0xE0BE08c77f415F577A1B3A9aD7a1Df1479564ec8, wait for it to confirm, then send this transaction again.
Approve only the amount you need, not an unlimited amount.
evidence: replayed with eth_call at block 31560417 (the state the transaction started from), same sender, value, data and gas limit
token error ERC20InsufficientAllowance(spender=0x317bca01Bb101C0F1E86C21576a4e14D92B02975, allowance=0, needed=1) at block 31560417
